an4.92:1.3: Idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo lābhī hoti ajjhattaṃ cetosamathassa na lābhī adhipaññādhammavipassanāya,
an4.92:1.4: idha pana bhikkhave ekacco puggalo lābhī adhipaññādhammavipassanāya na lābhī ajjhattaṃ cetosamathassa,
an4.92:1.5: idha pana bhikkhave ekacco puggalo na c' eva lābhī hoti ajjhattaṃ cetosamathassa na lābhī adhipaññādhammavipassanāya,
an4.92:1.6: idha pana bhikkhave ekacco puggalo lābhī c' eva hoti ajjhattaṃ cetosamathassa lābhī adhipaññādhammavipassanāya.
an4.92:1.7: Ime kho bhikkhave cattāro puggalo santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmin ti. 93. 1.
